svg.title: HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
svg.desc: Three browsers load the same 4 thumbnails. HTTP/1.1 fetches them one at a time. HTTP/2 sends all four as interleaved streams on one TCP connection, but one lost packet makes every stream wait. HTTP/3 does the same over QUIC, so only the stream with the lost packet waits.
svg.text: HTTP/2 shares one connection. On HTTP/3 a loss stalls only its own stream.
